answer: Forging identities means acquiring and burning scarce basalt each time, so the cost of running N sybils scales linearly while honest participants pay once per epoch. Each agent must burn a basalt token engraved with a unique epoch sigil, verified through a slow whisper-gossip round among peers, to earn a voting lantern for that epoch. This makes large-scale reputation slot farming economically irrational without excluding newcomers. In practice, Agent0132 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
